## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): e-side n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, 0 → 10 T), h-side n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T)

Raw first: |Rxx|(B) with detected minima, then |Rxx| vs 1/B against integer-ν ticks for the nominal density, then the 1/B FFT (degree-4 B-space background) and `sdh_onset`. Channel arithmetic R = (sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/−1e6); T = 1.24 ± 0.03 K on both; I_drain 9.8–9.9 nA throughout (no sag). **Read, run 7 (hole, nominal 1.2×10¹²):** clean oscillations from ~1.3 T, Rxx → ~10 Ω minima at 1.68/2.04 T, one dominant tone **F = 12.6 T** = nh/4e for **n = 1.22×10¹²** (nominal 1.20) — the run-5 absolute density scale (c_tg = geometry prior) is good to ~2 % on this side; a weaker 5–7 T component sits near the background residual. Rxx rises to 590 Ω at 10 T (ν ≈ 5, entering the zero-LL region). **Read, run 6 (electron, nominal 3.2×10¹²):** QH-quality minima (Rxx → 0) from 1.4 T; tones **29.4 T (strongest), 22.3, 14.8, 7.3 T** (the 7.3 T tone is flagged near-residual). Two readings fit at one density: (i) an ABAB-like light/heavy pair 7.3 + 29.4 = 36.7 T → n = 3.55×10¹² (+11 %) with 22.3 T the difference tone; (ii) a single 4-fold band at 29.4 T → 2.84×10¹² (−11 %) with the rest mixing/background. Minima doublets (1.40/1.47, 1.85/1.99, 2.31/2.45, 5.91/6.08 T) are consistent with the series region B (n + 0.43×10¹²) or with a second band — not separable here. A **500 Ω Rxx anomaly at 8–9.5 T** (ν ≈ 15–17 for n ≈ 3.3×10¹²) is far too large for an ordinary SdH maximum in a 16-fold-zero-LL system: candidate LL crossing (ABAB hallmark) or a mosaic feature — a single-density trace cannot localize it. **Take:** the device shows textbook quantum oscillations above ~1 T at base; the stacking read is ambiguous at fixed n and needs the (n, B) plane — plan step 3, the D = 0 Landau fan from 0.8 T.

"""sdh-spot-check read on runs 6 (electron, n=+3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n=-1.2e12), both D = 0 (run-5 cal).
Raw R(B) first, then SdH: minima in 1/B, per-trace FFT (sdh_fft), onset (sdh_onset), Onsager density vs nominal."""
from scipy.signal import find_peaks, savgol_filter
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

def load_spot(rid):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return r, B[o], R[o], I[o], r.col("T_sample")[o]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
for k, (rid, n_nom) in enumerate([(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    r, B, R, I, T = load_spot(rid)
    Ra = np.abs(R)
    print(f"\n=== run {rid}: rows {r.rows}, B {B.min():.3f}-{B.max():.3f} T, T {T.mean():.3f}+-{T.std():.3f} K, "
          f"I_drain {I.min()*1e9:.2f}..{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA, |R| {Ra.min():.1f}..{Ra.max():.0f} Ohm, interrupted={r.interrupted}")
    ax[0, k].plot(B, Ra, "-", lw=0.8); ax[0, k].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, k].set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)")
    ax[0, k].set_title(f"run {rid}: raw |Rxx|(B), n_nom = {n_nom:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    m = B > 1.2
    Rs = savgol_filter(Ra[m], 7, 2)
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-Rs, prominence=8, distance=5)
    Bm = B[m][mins]
    print("Rxx minima (B>1.2 T, prom>8 Ohm): " + ", ".join(f"{b:.2f}" for b in Bm))
    ax[0, k].plot(Bm, Ra[m][mins], "rv", ms=5)
    nhe = abs(n_nom) * 1e16 * cst.h / cst.e
    ax[1, k].plot(1 / B[m], Ra[m], "-", lw=0.8); ax[1, k].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, k].set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)")
    for nu in range(1, 40):
        x = nu / nhe
        if x < (1 / B[m]).max():
            ax[1, k].axvline(x, color="gray", lw=0.4, ls=":")
            if nu % 4 == 0: ax[1, k].text(x, Ra[m].max() * 0.95, str(nu), fontsize=6, ha="center")
    ax[1, k].set_title(f"|Rxx| vs 1/B; dotted = integer nu for n_nom (nh/e = {nhe:.1f} T)")
    f, spec = sdh_fft(Ra[:, None], B, b_range=(1.5, 10.0), nfft=2048, bg_degree=4, log=False)
    spec = spec[0]; sel = f > 2
    pk, _ = find_peaks(spec[sel], prominence=0.1 * spec[sel].max())
    top = sorted(zip(spec[sel][pk], f[sel][pk]), reverse=True)[:6]
    print("FFT [1.5,10] T peaks: " + ", ".join(f"{ff:.1f} T ({a/top[0][0]:.2f}) -> n4 {4*ff*cst.e/cst.h*1e-16:.2f}e12" for a, ff in top))
    ax[2, k].plot(f, spec / spec[sel].max(), lw=0.9); ax[2, k].set_xlim(0, 80); ax[2, k].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2, k].set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm)")
    for lab, F in [("nh/4e", nhe / 4), ("nh/e", nhe)]:
        ax[2, k].axvline(F, color="r", ls="--", lw=0.8); ax[2, k].text(F, 0.9, lab, color="r", fontsize=7)
    ax[2, k].set_title(f"SdH FFT, B in [1.5, 10] T (deg-4 bg); nominal F_L = {nhe/4:.1f} T")
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(Ra, B, b_lo=1.0, r_full_scale=5e3); print(on.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"onset: {e}")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 3: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), B 0.8 → 10 T × n = −1.24 … +3.20×10¹²

> **05:28** · landau-fan D=0: B slow 0.8->10 T, 167 rows (uniform 1/B 0.008 T^-1 to 4.27 T, then 0.15 T); fast n -1.24..+3.20e12 in 0.04 (112 pts) co-swept (Vtg,Vbg) on the run-5 D=0 line; sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1 s; ends at 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~13:38** (≈8h10m)

Plan step 3 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`), on the operator's request. Runs 6/7 (ana) show QH-quality oscillations from ~1.0–1.3 T at base; the hole-side tone (12.6 T = nh/4e for 1.22×10¹² vs 1.20 nominal) confirms the run-5 density scale to ~2 %, but the electron-side spectrum (29.4 + 22.3 + 14.8 + 7.3 T) and the 500 Ω anomaly at 8–9.5 T are ambiguous at a single density — the (n, B) plane is what separates one straight 4-fold fan (ABCA) from two interpenetrating fans with crossings (ABAB) or curved Dirac-block lines (ABCB), and separates the region-B mosaic doublets (constant offset +0.43×10¹²) from a second band (offset ∝ n). **Design.** Fast axis: the run-5 D = 0 line, n = −1.24 … +3.20×10¹² in 0.04 steps (112 co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) points, ≥ 8 mV inside both validators; 6 points per ν at 1 T). Slow axis: **uniform in 1/B** (0.008 T⁻¹, ≈ 1 filling factor per row at n = 3.2×10¹²) from 0.8 T until the step reaches 0.15 T at 4.27 T, then 0.15 T to 10 T — 167 rows; this samples every ν equally instead of oversampling high B, and feeds `sdh_fft` per column directly. Dwell 1.0 s at τ = 0.3 s/24 dB: as on the run-5 map, a quasi-continuous ramp so the 4τ group delay is a uniform ~1-point shift toward higher n (correctable), not a settling error. Sensitivity fixed at 100 µV (10 kΩ FS): runs 6/7 span 0–590 Ω (0.2–6 % FS); near-CNP points above ~7 T may soft-clip (ν = 0 region) — we read that line's position, not its magnitude — the run-4 lesson applied. **Coverage trade:** D = 0 only (a finite-D fan is plan step 5b, only if needed); the hole side stops at −1.24×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) — ν_h ≤ 4 above 1.3 T there; B starts at 0.8 T because no oscillation content exists below ~1 T at T_e ≈ 8 K (runs 6/7). **Price:** calibrated on run 5 (1.14 s/pt incl. the second Keithley write, 3.5 s flyback, 2 s slow delay + 3 s magnet settle → 136 s/row) → 6.3 h rows + 73 min ramp 0 → 10 T = 7.5 h, realistic +8 % ≈ 8 h 10 m; ends at **10 T** with gates parked at 0 (next step rides down). **Checkpoints** (`hera-watch` digests): first rows at ~0.8 T (≈ 12 min: rail? leakage? R(n) shape vs run 5's D = 0 cut), then re-form the partial fan at ~2 T (row ≈ 75, ~3 h) and at the 4.27 T segment boundary (~5.3 h) — abort if a row rails broadly, the leak guard trips, T leaves 1.0–1.5 K, or no ν-lines are visible by 2 T.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 0.8 -> 10 T (1/B-uniform then 0.15 T) x n fast along the run-5 D = 0 line ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration (run 5, ana; run-7 SdH F = 12.6 T confirms the n scale to ~2 %) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

# --- fast axis: n along D = 0 in 0.04e12 steps, both gates >= 8 mV inside the committed validators
DN, MARGIN = 0.04, 0.008
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(-1.40, 3.40 + 1e-9, DN), 3)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
ok = (Vtg_vec >= TG_MIN + MARGIN) & (Vtg_vec <= TG_MAX - MARGIN) & (Vbg_vec >= BG_MIN + MARGIN) & (Vbg_vec <= BG_MAX - MARGIN)
n_vec, Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = n_vec[ok], Vtg_vec[ok], Vbg_vec[ok]
assert len(n_vec) == 112, len(n_vec)
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.abs(_Dchk).max() < 1e-6 and np.allclose(_nchk, n_vec)

# --- slow axis: uniform 1/B (d = 0.008 T^-1) from 0.8 T until dB reaches 0.15 T (~4.27 T), then 0.15 T steps to 10 T
d, dBmax = 0.008, 0.15
Bc = np.sqrt(dBmax / d)
seg1 = 1 / np.arange(1 / 0.8, 1 / Bc - 1e-12, -d)
seg2 = np.arange(seg1[-1] + dBmax, 10.0 + 1e-9, dBmax); seg2[-1] = 10.0
B_vec = np.round(np.hstack((seg1, seg2)), 4)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and len(B_vec) == 167, len(B_vec)
print(f"fast: {len(n_vec)} pts, n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 (0.04); Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V")
print(f"slow: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(seg1)} rows uniform-1/B to {seg1[-1]:.3f} T, dB {np.diff(B_vec)[0]*1e3:.1f} -> {np.diff(B_vec)[len(seg1)-2]*1e3:.0f} mT; then {len(seg2)} rows at {dBmax} T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left the magnet at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY, I_TRIP = 1.0, 2.0, 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row): 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D=0: B slow {B_vec[0]}->{B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows (uniform 1/B d=0.008 T^-1 to {seg1[-1]:.2f} T, then 0.15 T); "
                  f"fast n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 in 0.04 ({len(n_vec)} pts) co-swept (Vtg, Vbg) on the run-5 D=0 line; "
                  f"sr1 100 uV; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; T base")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan, region-A cal run 5 (ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); '
              f'slow B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows (1/B-uniform 0.008 T^-1 to {seg1[-1]:.2f} T, 0.15 T above); '
              f'fast n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 in 0.04 ({len(n_vec)} pts): Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}, Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # gates home; the field stays where the sweep left it (10 T on completion) — the next step rides it down, never re-traverses
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm

assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.05), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm = 1.4 % FS; MR + SdH maxima at high B size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 10 T (the hole-side spot check rides it down) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
